notes.title: Devblog update
notes.notes:
Hello. I'm currently dealing with press (twitch streamers), I'll try to develop the game further in the meantime even though after this "development hell" I went through with the bugs.

I've read topics about game developers playing their own game, if they enjoy it or not. I'm kind of like the developer that enjoys the game but likes to cheat, going through rooms in the engine and starting the game in different rooms.

Playing through the whole game before publishing it would take a lot of time away from a lot of things that could be done.

That is why I am curious what the streamers see when they play the game. I am mostly looking for if the position of the text changes when you switch rooms. Since I had this problem with the Keep room.

Best regards,
Mibli.

notes.title: Patch 0.3.7 - Player movement bug #3 and smarter enemy movement.
notes.notes:
I made the player bounce a tiny bit when colliding with invisible walls. I hope this should fix the movement and that it works as intended.

Enemy movement AI has become much smarter. But they seem to clamp together into a "long distance from eachother" group later on (but without building a formation (maybe because the Deephold map is not that big)). That might be a good thing for that map.

If you see any mob walking outside the room, please report it to me.

notes.title: Patch 0.3.0
notes.notes:
[h1]Features[/h1]

Added shadows.
Added shaders.
Made loot drop.
Added whip weapon with it's own weapon technique. Whip weapons has close to medium range, bleeds and pushes enemies back.
Added waves to fight in Buzan Fields.

[h1]Maps[/h1]

Buzan Empire map is done.
Buzan Fields has been added.

[h1]Two new enemy types[/h1]

Bitefrog
Voidspawn Bitefrog

[h1]Campaign and Missions[/h1]

The story continues.
Working on Campaign Table and Mission Board.

[h1]Sounds[/h1]

NPCs greet you.
Footstep sounds for different environments.
Weapon sounds.
Enemy sounds.

[h1]Building[/h1]

Added an upgrade that you learn at Buzan Empire: Settlements. With Settlements you can pick where you want your building zones to be. But you can only pick once, so pick a good place!

[h1]Loot Table[/h1]

Added Entangled Whip, a common weapon.

[h1]Graphics[/h1]

Changed the tree resource graphics and it falls down when you chop it too much.
The player now looks more like an exile rather than a sinister being.
